US Leading Indicators

The Conference Board Leading Economic Index (LEI) for the US Fell Slightly in January

Latest Press Release

Updated: Thursday, March 19, 2026

The Conference Board Leading Economic Index (LEI) for the US inched down by 0.1% in January 2026 to 97.5 (2016=100), following a 0.2% decline in December.

The Conference Board Coincident Economic Index (CEI) for the US rose by 0.3% in January 2026 to 115.3 (2016=100).
